In the treatment of migraine, buclizine hydrochloride is given in usual doses of 12.5 mg at the start of an attack or when one is known to be imminent; children aged 10 to 14 years may be giv- en 6.25 mg and older children the usual adult dose. In pruritic skin disorders the usual dose of buclizine hydrochlo- ride is 25 to 50 mg daily.
